title: Refund Policy
observations: Voluntary non-travel on an operated flight normally does not qualify for a ticket refund. Published exceptions include specified disruption and bereavement circumstances. The stated bereavement window for a non-travelling immediate family member is ten days before the flight.
scope_note: This is a short source note, not an exhaustive policy snapshot. Exact family definitions and application requirements need reviewer confirmation.

title: Terms and Conditions
access_method: Official-domain indexed excerpts retrieved; direct page rendering requires JavaScript
observations: The indexed terms describe cancellation within 24 hours with a cancellation-fee deduction, unavailable less than two hours before departure. Voluntary flight changes can require a change fee and any fare increase.
scope_note: Full-page human verification remains pending. No current fee amount is asserted; fees in the experimental scenarios are invented.

title: Our Customer Commitment
observations: The booking-error cancellation option describes a 24-hour window for direct bookings, excluding bookings for travel within 24 hours and specified holiday bookings.
scope_note: The page states that the customer commitment is not legally or contractually binding. This source supplies a scenario topic; the experiment does not determine real passenger entitlements.

title: Seat changes and refunds
observations: A voluntary move to a cheaper paid seat does not receive the price difference back. The page separately describes refund circumstances following airline-driven seating changes.
scope_note: The experimental policy simplifies the seat-change distinction and is not a complete reproduction of the carrier's terms.

title: Refunds for extra options
access_method: Official Netherlands English page text retrieved
observations: Extra-baggage refunds can be requested within 24 hours of purchase or after rebooking to a non-KLM-operated flight. A paid meal unavailable after qualifying cancellation or rebooking can also support a refund request.
scope_note: The experiment uses only selected eligibility concepts. Other options and full linked conditions are outside this source note.

title: Cancellation and refund
access_method: Official Czech-region English page text retrieved
observations: Refundability depends on fare conditions and used segments. The page describes payment to the original payment method and calculation of the unused portion for partly used tickets.
scope_note: Do not infer that every unused ticket is fully refundable. The pilot explicitly supplies fictional fare values and refundability facts.
